description: Characteristics of Night Bus Users is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by TfL. Breakdown of night and day bus users by gender, age, ethnicity, household income, disability, frequency and purpose of use. This dataset is included in the Greater London Authority's Night Time Observatory. Click here to find out more. Coverage: TfL. The publisher named on the listing is TfL. Its keywords include nto. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
